evidence.title: Plate V: 黄花阵 Huanghua Zhen, the maze
evidence.excerpt_other: A-peu-près au centre du labyrinthe s'élève un édifice octogone établi sur un soubassement circulaire.
evidence.summary: Square, in a wood, inside a wall and then a river with rocks and flowers; small wooden bridges and gates. Octagon with arches on its large faces, windows on the small ones, cul-de-four dome with a small lantern, circular stair round the base. Apparently a throne inside. Small casino at the east entry.

evidence.title: Engraving 5: 黄花阵 Huanghua Zhen, the maze
evidence.excerpt_other: This was a maze or labyrinth with carved brick walls about shoulder high, surmounted by little slender conventional pines.
evidence.summary: A two-storey building at the back overlooks it. Round stairs in the centre to an octagonal pavilion where, says the old caretaker Lu, mechanical singing birds were kept (hearsay).

evidence.title: 玉明 侍游御園記 (in 蕉軒隨錄)
evidence.locator: 蕉軒隨錄, 御園侍游 (line 336 of the corpus file)
evidence.excerpt_zh: ◎御园侍游玉将军（明）有《侍游御园记》，成竹坪同年（林）曾属予代作跋语，恭书于后。按，《记》云：“咸丰六年秋七月二十一日，奉旨：本日散朝后，著玉明、肃顺自备鞍马，午初一刻进西南门，在山高水长伺候。有顷，上从内乘船，至山高水长后阁扇下船，出前门，谕玉明、肃顺暨珠勒亨、西拉布、托云、德勒格尔、伊勒东阿等脱去外褂。上乘马，命七臣随行。自山高水长游藻园，至厂地，过汇芳书院，复由紫碧山房至鱼跃鸢飞少坐。过蕊珠宫门，至黄花磴进茶毕，往西洋楼海宴堂，至转马台，过小角门，至狮子林清淑斋赏饭。左右四卓，命七臣坐，并奉温谕可饱食，非外边筵宴比也。上命膳房先给七臣面各一器，上进面，复进饭，颁赏御用菜蔬，七臣叩头谢。上进粥，复赏粥毕。随驾起行，由宝相寺、法慧寺、谐奇趣过明春门，至雷峰夕照马头，坐如在天上船，游福海。上命笔砚作诗毕，至渊氵亭镜澈马头下船。进丽春门骑马，由旧园东墙根过敷春堂，游西大堤汉城关，至含辉楼下马，命七臣散归。玉明自道光十一年由侍卫擢厕御前二十余年，仰邀优渥，得遍瞻御园盛景。欣感之余，谨作记以纪荣遇。”
evidence.summary: A rare first-hand record of a day in the garden four years before its destruction. The emperor takes seven officials by a named route from 山高水長 through 藻園, 彚芳書院, 紫碧山房 and 魚躍鳶飛, past 蕊珠宫門, on to 海宴堂 in the 西洋樓, a meal at 清淑齋 in 獅子林, 寳相寺, 法慧寺, 諧奇趣, by boat on 福海, then 敷春堂 and 含暉楼. All were standing then.

evidence.title: 万花阵 and 花园门; 线法山 and 螺蛳牌楼, yaffin 系列02, 13
evidence.summary: Lead: the maze gate 花园门 is shaped like a Western clock case with two brass doors; the maze 89 x 59 m, walls about 1.2 m high and over 1,600 m long; the hill 线法山 has a gate each side, the east one called 螺蛳牌楼. Check against the engravings.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 西洋楼
evidence.summary: The editors walk the strip from west to east with completion dates and plaques: 谐奇趣 1751, 养雀笼 1759, then the fountains and the perspective walls, with their mechanical details. They put the whole at about 2% of the gardens.

evidence.title: 圆明园水利文物遗迹研究
evidence.summary: Inventory of water works: the 藻园 one-arch inlet, main source, now buried under the wall and undug; 黄花阵 inlet with good piers; 鉴碧亭 sluice, abandoned 2007; 狮子林 七孔闸, chief outlet, buried in the 2000s behind a new weir with only a stub showing; west water tower fed from a three-arch inlet.

evidence.title: 西洋楼区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12205, free part
evidence.summary: Report's opening: the strip runs 860 m east-west, up to 300 m wide in the west and 65 m at its narrowest, about 70,000 m2, built 1747-1783. A central axis divides it into about five sections, each with its own north-south axis, thirteen units from 谐奇趣 to 线法墙. Survey results are paywalled.

twins.basis: S414; S415 p.83 lists Lancaster's claim. S415 pp.98-99 (Droguet p.24): masonry walls here are a novelty with only distant forebears, e.g. the Cretan labyrinth printed by Fischer von Erlach.

twins.name: 汉普顿宫迷宫 Hampton Court Maze
twins.relation: Comparable: same court, era or type
twins.tells: Plan type: paths and a central lookout
twins.basis: S414 (PDF p.6): the engraving allows comparison with the mazes at Versailles (Le Nôtre) and Hampton Court; those are of trees, ours has flowers and, S415 p.99, brick walls. MIT essay S405: a kin of 17th c. European mazes. S423: built after a European maze.

facts.value: Copper engraving no. 5 per S02. Engraving calls it 花园. Also 万花阵 (S06; S42). S06 89 x 59 m; walls 1.2 m high. S06 wall length 16 km looks wrong, check on plan. Rebuilt in modern times (S06). Round 6 replaced frontage 89 m. Round 6 replaced depth 59 m.
